name: greptile
description: Review changes locally with the Greptile CLI, address PR feedback, and iterate to a 5/5 Greptile score.

interface.shortDescription: Review changes and resolve PR feedback.
interface.longDescription: Use Greptile to review changes locally with the CLI before opening a PR, address unresolved feedback and failing checks, or run Greploop — a local fix-review loop that iterates until the change reaches a 5/5 review, then syncs the result to your PR.
defaultPrompt: Review my changes before opening a PR.
Address unresolved feedback on my PR.
Run Greploop until this PR reaches 5/5.
